setup_fastcsp_logger: setup a FastCSP logger with configurable file and console output handlers
print_fastcsp_header: print the FastCSP banner header with restart info and stage details
log_config_pretty: log a configuration dictionary in pretty-printed JSON format to the logger
log_stage_start: log the start of a workflow stage with an optional description message
log_error: log an exception with its type and full traceback in a standardized format
